He wrote a short poem in verse for her birthday.
他為她的生日寫了一首短詩。
Children enjoy stories told in simple verse.
孩子們喜歡用簡單韻文說的故事。

verse.zh: 詩節、（歌曲的）段落；聖經的節
ai: We sang the first verse of the song together.
我們一起唱了這首歌的第一段。
She read a verse from the Bible aloud.
她大聲朗讀一節聖經經文。
In the story, the devil tempts the young man.
故事裡，魔鬼誘惑了那個年輕人。
Many old tales describe the devil with horns and a tail.
許多古老傳說把魔鬼描述成有角和尾巴。
That little devil hid my shoes again.
那個小淘氣又把我的鞋子藏起來了。
The poor devil lost his job last week.
那個可憐的傢伙上週丟了工作。
